stories.title: Game 2 Recap — Cubs Spoil Skubal's Dodgers Debut
stories.angle: Javier Assad was excellent against a tough Dodger lineup. Dansby Swanson hit a solo homer off Skubal's first pitch of the 3rd inning to break it open. PCA and Hoerner drove in runs with singles. Skubal pitched 6 innings of 2-run ball (6 K, 2 BB) but took the loss. Dodgers have now lost 5 in a row. NO score in tweet per has_score=False insight.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Dansby Swanson took Skubal's first pitch of the third and drove it to left-center. Wrigley erupted.

Assad was excellent. Hoerner and PCA drove in runs. The Cubs spoiled Tarik Skubal's Dodgers debut in convincing fashion.

Two down. One more to go.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Series Sweep in Reach — Dodgers Can't Get Right
stories.angle: Cubs lead this series 2-0 with a chance to sweep the best team in the NL (Dodgers 69-45). Dodgers on a 5-game skid and can't string wins together. Cubs No. 1 in the NL Wild Card at 65-49. Bold take framing.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
The Dodgers are 0-2 in this series and have now lost five in a row. The Cubs are the No. 1 NL Wild Card team.

Today at 1:20 PM CT, Imanaga takes the ball for a chance to sweep Ohtani's squad at Wrigley.

They're doing it.

#Cubs #FlyTheW #GoCubs

stories.title: Imanaga's Hot Streak — The Best Cubs Pitcher Right Now
stories.angle: Stat breakdown of Imanaga's last 6 starts: 1.77 ERA, 31 K, 6 BB over 35.2 innings. He's the Cubs' most consistent arm heading into today's Game 3. Informative setup for today's matchup.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Shota Imanaga's last six starts: 1.77 ERA, 31 strikeouts, 6 walks across 35.2 innings.

The Cubs' most consistent arm right now is squaring off against a Dodgers lineup that just can't get a run across.

That's a good matchup to be in.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: PCA MVP Watch — 7.3 fWAR, Leading All Position Players in MLB
stories.angle: PCA leads all position players in fWAR. His teammates are campaigning for him. Bold take: he's the best player in the NL and it's not close.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong leads every MLB position player in fWAR at 7.3 this season.

Even Nico Hoerner was publicly making the case after Tuesday's win.

The best player in the NL plays on the North Side. That's not a debate anymore.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Pre-Game Hype — Sweep Attempt, 1:20 PM CT
stories.angle: Imanaga faces a slumping Dodgers team that can't win a game. Cubs at Wrigley, looking for the sweep. Most winnable matchup of the series. Maximum hype for the day game.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Imanaga. Wrigley. 1:20 PM CT.

The Cubs are one win away from sweeping the best record in baseball. The Dodgers haven't won in five games.

Today's a great day to make it six.

#Cubs #FlyTheW #GoCubs

stories.title: Roster News — Palencia to IL (Right Elbow Inflammation)
stories.angle: Daniel Palencia goes to the 15-day IL with right elbow inflammation — one day after being recalled from Triple-A. Rotation/bullpen depth continues to be tested in August. Deadline haul (Gausman, Holmes, Zeferjahn, Garrett) built for exactly this.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Daniel Palencia goes to the 15-day IL with right elbow inflammation — one day after being recalled from Triple-A.

One step forward, one step back. The deadline haul (Gausman, Holmes, Zeferjahn, Garrett) was built specifically for moments like this one.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Cardinals Free-Fall — Rival Watch
stories.angle: Cardinals have completely fallen out of the wild card picture. Lost 7 of 10, sitting at 54-57. The No. 1 NL Wild Card spot is occupied and it's not St. Louis. Sharp jab angle.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
The Cardinals are 54-57. They've lost seven of their last 10. They're sitting 15th in the NL Wild Card standings.

The No. 1 spot is occupied, and it's not by anyone from St. Louis.

That mid-season Cardinals surge feels like a very long time ago.

#Cubs #GoCubs #NorthSiders
